meta.title: Turtles all the way down
meta.author: Skyrunner / Brain Control (credited in the intro's nfo and on Demozoo for the music of Turtles all the way down)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Turtles all the way down, Brain Control's 64k intro that won the PC 64k intro competition at Revision 2013 (https://www.pouet.net/prod.php?which=61204), made with Tunefish 4 (20 instruments, 230 BPM). Enigma Studio 4, the tool it was made with, was released with the intro project and this song under CC0 1.0. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: The Tunefish 4 song of the 2013 engine (.tf4m, 110 values per instrument) was translated by `synth-convert tf4m` to the final Tunefish layout (parameter indices, mod-matrix sources, targets and amount law, reverb width), converted to the unified synth (instrument kind 64 with its insert effects as track devices, kinds 65-73), then imported with `song import` (one clip per lane, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Events are placed at the start of the 512-frame block that fires them in the Tunefish player. Instruments and effects are the unified equivalents of the final Tunefish 4 ones, which differ in places from the 2013 engine the intro used: the 2013 LFO sine spans -0.5 to 1.5 (instruments 9, 13, 19, 20 use an LFO), its generator modulation reads a shorter sine table, it does not band-limit the wavetable and it rounds where the final engine truncates. The random per-voice detune GenSlop is not converted and the wavetable phases are drawn from a different random sequence.
